sloka: प्राकारैर्विविधाकारैः शोभिताश्च शिलातलैः ।तत्रैव च वनोद्देशे वैडूर्यमणिसन्निभैः ।। ७.४२.१३ ॥
transliteration: prākārairvividhākāraiḥ śobhitāśca śilātalaiḥ ।tatraiva ca vanoddeśe vaiḍūryamaṇisannibhaiḥ ।। 7.42.13 ॥

translations.english: The area was embellished with diverse enclosures and rock surfaces, and within that forest region, there were spots that shimmered like lapis lazuli gems.
translations.hindi: हे देवपूजित महामने ! हे! भगवन्‌ ! अतः हनुमानजी के सम्बन्ध का जो यथार्थे वृत्तान्त हो, सो विस्तार पूर्वक कहिए
